dataChanges.why: `battleRole` is not a player word and not an event-player test: the engine evaluates it as 'the controller is the battle's defender' (battle.defenderPlayerId === the controller), so the engine does not bind it to an opponent. MPQ-P8 binds 'your opponent' to the other side of the battle only when the controller is a party to it, and 'defender' covers exactly that case. The printed text ('only while your opponent is attacking') is also met when two other players fight (MP 2: the controller picks an attacking opponent), which 'defender' refuses, so the condition must change. The edit flag stays true. Edit done: the condition is now battleActive and isActivePlayer { player: "opponent" } (the battle's attacker is the active player), and the ability holds opponentFrom "battle", so the opponent is the other side of the battle when the controller is in it (no choice) and the attacking opponent otherwise.
